Page: Artificial intelligence, Arabic Wikipedia (ar.wikipedia.org)

Lead

Artificial intelligence (Arabic: الذكاء الاصطناعي, also written الذكاء الصناعي or الذكاء الصنعي; English: Artificial Intelligence, abbreviated AI) is the ability of computer systems to perform tasks usually associated with human intelligence, such as learning, reasoning, problem solving, perception, and decision making. It is a research field within engineering, mathematics, and computer science. It develops and studies methods and software that enable machines to perceive their environment, and uses learning and reasoning to take actions that improve their chances of reaching specific goals.

Applications

Prominent AI applications include advanced web search engines, chatbots, virtual assistants, self-driving vehicles, and game playing and analysis in strategy games such as chess and Go. Since the 2020s, generative AI has become widely available for creating images, sound, and video from text prompts.

Goals

Traditional goals of AI research include learning, reasoning, knowledge representation, planning, natural language processing, perception, and support for robotics.

To achieve these goals, AI researchers have used many techniques, including:

search in state space

mathematical optimization

formal logic

neural networks

AI also draws on statistics, operations research, economics, psychology, linguistics, philosophy, neuroscience, and other fields.

Some companies, such as OpenAI, Google, DeepMind, and Meta, aim to build artificial general intelligence (AGI): AI that can perform almost any cognitive task at a level no lower than a human's.

History

AI was founded as an academic discipline in 1956. The field has gone through several waves of optimism, each followed by disappointment and reduced funding, known as "AI winters."

Funding and interest grew sharply after 2012, when graphics processing units (GPUs) began being used to speed up neural networks, and deep learning outperformed earlier AI techniques. This growth accelerated after 2017 with the introduction of the Transformer architecture.
